candidate_evidence.quote: ICT-107: Autologous dendritic cells pulsed with peptides associated with tumor antigens

role_evidence.quote: ICT-107: Autologous dendritic cells pulsed with peptides associated with tumor antigens

agents.drug_class_hint: autologous dendritic cell vaccine pulsed with six tumour-associated antigen peptides
agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: Reinfusion with the pulsed dendritic cells should stimulate cytotoxic T cells to specifically target glioblastoma tumour cells.

agents.drug_class_hint: cellular placebo control for the dendritic cell vaccine

role_evidence.quote: Arm 1 will receive ICT-107 in combination with the standard of care, temozolomide (TMZ).
Arm 2 will receive TMZ with a blinded control.

source_quote.quote: All subjects must have glioblastoma tissue that has tumor assessment for MGMT methylation status prior to randomization (for stratification).
Subjects with glioblastoma mutated IDH by Immunohistochemistry (IHC)

coder_notes: Dendritic cell vaccine is an excluded intervention type; no pharmacological candidate. HLA-A2 positivity is a germline/immune-typing requirement and is not recorded as a tumour biomarker. IDH-mutant glioblastoma is an exclusion criterion, so IDH-wildtype is effectively required (coded cns5 on that basis, though the record also uses the term glioblastoma multiforme). Placebo is autologous monocyte-enriched PBMC, listed as the control comparator.
